description:
SBA custom UI: an "Environments" page — the standard Applications view with an
        extra outer accordion level grouping apps by their info.tags.environment
        (environment → application → node). Reuses SBA's own components (sba-status, …) and
        the useApplicationStore data. Built with Vite/Vue and shipped as a resources jar under
        META-INF/spring-boot-admin-server-ui/extensions/environments.
